description: privacy_mode = sensitive_conversation. Expected: no long-term memory write by default; transcript is redacted by default; policy signals only are retained; user can opt in to long-term retention via explicit consent. Tests that privacy_mode = sensitive_conversation suppresses durable writes and redacts transcripts per Part 7 and the test_sensitive_conversation_retention contract. Signal and memory-op traces are skeleton placeholders pending Stage 4 activation.

fixture_conventions.privacy_mode: sensitive_conversation: policy signals only retained by default; transcript redacted; no long-term memory write unless user explicitly opts in (Part 7 privacy_mode_compatibility table).
fixture_conventions.default_suppression: Long-term memory writes are suppressed by default. Session-state writes (non-persistent) are permitted for the duration of the session only.
fixture_conventions.transcript_redaction: Transcript content is redacted from the event log by default while this mode is active. The redacted_explanation field (SensitiveField) is used where transcript evidence is required for policy replay.
fixture_conventions.opt_in_path: User can opt in to long-term retention by explicitly accepting a consent prompt. The opt-in event must appear in the event log with caused_by pointing to the user's consent utterance.
fixture_conventions.policy_signals_retained: Policy-layer signals (SpeakDecision action_type, primary_reason_code, timing) are retained even under sensitive_conversation mode — the replay invariant (#5) must hold even when transcript is redacted.
fixture_conventions.expected_events_markers: event_type strings are fixture-internal role labels. Filled in at Stage 4 activation.

signal_trace.note: Per-frame scripted values are placeholders. To be finalized when Stage 4 is activated.

memory_op_trace.note: Privacy mode activation, suppressed long-term writes, transcript redaction, and optional opt-in path to be scripted at Stage 4 activation.
